ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.

2. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

7. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

8. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.

9. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.

   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electro- Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
